Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance Onboarding Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.Key ResponsibilitiesContribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices. Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions. Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions. Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks. Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.What We're Looking ForBachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments. Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly. Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus). Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight HeroFreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐nativeinfrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.Key Responsibilities:Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM

Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Advanced After Effects Youtube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects Youtube Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:

If you just use LinkedIn's\ "Easy Apply\" you will not beconsidered for this role.

Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.

About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we're looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients' branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)

Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:

Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:

  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.
  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.
  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.
  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.

Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a "design eye": the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive

The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.

Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

The Test:

In order to evaluate candidates, we have developed a test of your After Effects video editing skills, below are instructions and links to all the files you will need to complete it:

In order to apply, please copy and paste the link below into your browser to take a quick test in After Effects. It includes all the materials you will need to complete it, along with step-by-step instructions:

If you just use LinkedIn's\ "Easy Apply\" you will not beconsidered for this role.

The deadline to submit your finished video is Friday, May 29th. If your submission is good, we will reach out to schedule an interview. If you have any questions about the test, the position, or our company, please contact Cyan on Linkedin or email him here:

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software .Net
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta De Software .Net em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.

O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa

O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP;
    Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.Io.

O Que Oferecemos:

Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Assistência Odontológica

Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito.

ღ Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais.

Previdência Privada: Planeje o futuro com segurança.

Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Sucesso compartilhado com todos.

Fretado das estações Barra Funda e Santana

Gympass: Acesso a academias e atividades físicas para manter a saúde em dia.

Reset Day: 1 dia OFF por ano para aproveitar da melhor forma.

Por que escolher a Dimensa?

Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão!

Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença, #VEMFAZERPARTEDAONDAVERDE

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we're looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:

Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:

  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.
  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.
  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.
  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.

Additional Requirements:

  • Advanced English proficiency

  • Have a "design eye": the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive

The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.

Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

description:

  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business

  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.Technical Requirements ERP:SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday

If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack com forte atuação em Java e Angular, para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de aplicações web corporativas. O profissional fará parte de um time multidisciplinar, contribuindo com soluções robustas, escaláveis e orientadas à qualidade de software.

Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações fullstack com foco em backend Java e frontend Angular;

- Implementar APIs e serviços utilizando Spring Boot;

- Atuar na modelagem e persistência de dados com JPA/Hibernate;

- Desenvolver componentes corporativos e integrações com EJB, quando aplicável;

- Participar da análise técnica, refinamento de requisitos e estimativas de desenvolvimento;

- Garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, performance, segurança e qualidade de código;

- Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva em sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Colaborar com times de produto, QA, arquitetura e demais áreas técnicas;

- Apoiar a sustentação de ambientes produtivos e resolução de incidentes técnicos.

Requisitos técnicos

- Experiência sólida com Java;

- Experiência comAngular;

- Conhecimento emSpring Boot;

- Vivência com JPA/Hibernate;

- Experiência comEJB;

- Conhecimento emAPIs REST;

- Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e SQL;

- Vivência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;

- Conhecimento deboas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e versionamento.

- Capacidade de atuar tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na sustentação.

Diferenciais

- Experiência com microsserviços;

- Conhecimento emDocker e ambientes cloud;

- Experiência commensageria;

- Vivência com metodologias ágeis;

- Conhecimento emtestes automatizados;

- Experiência comsistemas corporativos e legados.

title: Especialista Técnico Sap I
description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesArquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean):Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia: Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema: Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria: Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio:Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio: Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos:Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo: Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade: Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica: Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.Requisitos e qualificaçõesEcossistema SAP:Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno:Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud:Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica:Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis:Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation To Portugal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer - Relocation To Portugal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • We are looking for experienced Java Developers to join an international and dynamic environment.
  • The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in Java development, with solid exposure to modern technologies and implementation projects.
  • Fluency in English (minimum B2 level) is required.
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and cloud environments.
  • Experience working with recent technology stacks and participating in implementation projects is highly valued.
  • Williness to relocate to Portugal

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee– our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and teambuilding activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL's headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, no46 em Lisboa or use the DPO's e-mail -. The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Remote Physics Expert - 79348
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert - 79348 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master's, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. title: Agentic Ai Engineer (Remote) Tooling, Frameworks, Prompts | Python | Ts
description:

Agentic AI EngineerRole overviewSamo Technologies is hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and scale production-grade AI agents that automate workflows, reason across tools, and integrate with modern enterprise systems. This role combines LLM application engineering, systems integration, and product thinking to deliver reliable agentic solutions for internal operations and customer-facing use cases.Key responsibilitiesDesign, build, and maintain agentic AI systems for real-world business workflows. Develop multi-step AI agents that can reason, plan, call tools, and execute tasks safely. Integrate agents with APIs, databases, internal platforms, third-party SaaS products, and MCP servers. Work with agent orchestration frameworks, tool abstractions, prompt pipelines, memory systems, and evaluation stacks. Build and maintain tool interfaces, function-calling layers, retrieval pipelines, and structured output systems. Evaluate and improve agent performance across accuracy, latency, reliability, observability, and cost. Implement guardrails, permission controls, monitoring, tracing, and failure recovery for production environments. Collaborate with product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify high-value automation opportunities. Translate business requirements into technical architecture, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. Stay current with advances in LLMs, agentic frameworks, MCP ecosystem standards, and AI infrastructure. Required qualificationsBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on work with Python or TypeScript. Proven experience building LLM-powered applications or AI agents in production or near-production environments. Strong understanding of tools, tool calling, function calling, and external system orchestration. Familiarity with MCP servers and the design of reusable tool interfaces for agentic systems. Experience with one or more agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar platforms. Experience integrating with REST APIs, webhooks, databases, vector stores, and cloud services. Solid understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, memory patterns, and agent evaluation methods. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, CI/CD, debugging, and system design. Professional English proficiency is required, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred qualificationsExperience deploying AI systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure. Familiarity with observability, tracing, and evaluation tools for AI systems. Experience building secure enterprise automations with role-based access and approval workflows. Knowledge of containerization, microservices, and distributed system design. Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. Technical skillsProgramming: Python, TypeScript, SQL. AI systems: LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, agent memory, tool-use patterns, structured generation. Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. Integrations: MCP servers, REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, OAuth, cloud services. Infrastructure: Docker, Git, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and cloud deployment workflows. Success profileThe ideal candidate is highly technical, execution-oriented, and product-minded. This person can move from prototype to production, balance speed with reliability, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Able to deploy their code to production. What this role will ownAgent architecture and orchestration design. Tool and MCP server integrations. Evaluation, monitoring, and reliability of deployed agents. Delivery of business automation use cases that produce measurable impact. Work styleComfortable working cross-functionally with leadership, product, and engineering teams. Able to operate independently and make sound technical decisions. Pragmatic about trade-offs between experimentation, maintainability, and time to value.

- Databricks: Familiaridade com a plataforma Databricks, uso de notebooks, clusters e integração com Data Lakes.
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Experiência avançada em modelagem, particionamento e otimização de custos e consultas no Google BigQuery.

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.

Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.

More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Especialista Em Customer Success
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Em Customer Success em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ESPECIALISTA EM CUSTOMER SUCCESS

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia para propor, criar e testar novas soluções
  • Cultura colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento

SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.

Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.

Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.

Conheça mais em:

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você é o ponto de contato direto entre o cliente e a Adaflow. Atende com autonomia, escuta com atenção, diagnostica com critério e resolve com precisão. Cada interação vira contexto, cada problema vira aprendizado, cada feedback vira melhoria.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Atuar na linha de frente nos canais oficiais da Adaflow: WhatsApp, e-mail, chat na plataforma/site e no sistema de tickets, mantendo sempre o tom de voz da empresa.
  • Ler o histórico do cliente antes de atender. Contexto é o que diferencia um atendimento bom de um excelente.
  • Acompanhar cada chamado do início ao fim, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Realizar follow-up ativo para confirmar a resolução dos problemas e medir a satisfação (NPS, CSAT).
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes sempre que o caso exigir um alinhamento mais próximo.
  • Conhecer profundamente o serviço prestado e o funcionamento do produto.
  • Diagnosticar problemas relatados, identificar a causa raiz e propor soluções adequadas, sem depender de roteiros engessados.
  • Prestar suporte de níveis 1 e 2, escalando casos complexos às áreas responsáveis quando necessário.
  • Orientar clientes sobre o uso correto da plataforma, de produtos, serviços e funcionalidades.
  • Sinalizar imediatamente sinais de cancelamento e de risco de churn, acionando as áreas responsáveis para ações de retenção.
  • Documentar todas as interações, soluções aplicadas e feedbacks no sistema, mantendo o histórico do cliente sempre atualizado e útil.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a base de conhecimento (FAQ, artigos de ajuda, scripts de atendimento), transformando aprendizados do dia a dia em material reaproveitável pelo time.
  • Identificar padrões recorrentes de problemas e abrir tickets estruturados para os times de produto, engenharia, operações ou tecnologia, com contexto suficiente para acelerar a solução.
  • Coletar, consolidar e traduzir o feedback dos clientes em aprendizado real para o produto e os processos. Não é só registrar: é interpretar, priorizar e comunicar com contexto para quem decide.
  • Mapear padrões, identificar pontos de atrito e propor melhorias na experiência ponta a ponta é parte central do trabalho, não um extra.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como tempo de resposta e de adoção, usando os dados para tomar decisões, propor mudanças e comunicar o status de forma proativa.
  • Antecipar problemas antes que o cliente precise abrir um chamado. Atendimento de verdade é o que evita o próximo ticket.

O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência prática em atendimento ou no sucesso do cliente, especialmente em tecnologia, contabilidade, SaaS ou Fintech.
  • Noções sobre rotinas financeiras, contábeis e/ou fiscais: você não precisa ser contador(a), mas precisa entender o contexto do cliente.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal excelente: clara, direta e empática.
  • Visão analítica: volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e CSAT fazem parte do seu dia a dia.
  • Autonomia real para atuar em ambiente remoto e dinâmico. Você organiza o próprio trabalho.
  • Repertório de ferramentas: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Take Blip, Zendesk, Zenvia, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares.
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com clientes insatisfeitos.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita: somos uma empresa global.
  • Formação em contabilidade ou estudantes de ciências contábeis.
  • Experiência em documentação de processos/Help Center.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e métricas de CS: Notion, Looker Studio, planilhas avançadas.
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e produto: você busca entender como funciona o que está atendendo.

NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas.

Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!
